normative_requirement_audit.scope_and_limits: Multi-domain intent retained; Stage 01 owns first-consumer specifications and small inputs only.
normative_requirement_audit.original_requirement: Lince workspaces let people author, import, inspect, combine and simulate models from microscopic structures through materials, pieces, assemblies, buildings, streets, cities, planets and astronomical systems. Smaller supported descriptions can include isotopes, particle populations or physical fields when their domain requires them. Atomic balls are one representation, not the smallest compulsory building block of the file format. Arbitrary addressable extent does not imply populated content, available knowledge or a valid solver at every scale.

normative_requirement_audit.scope_and_limits: Same local/hosted workspace with separate source authority; larger runtime delivery starts at Stage 02.
normative_requirement_audit.original_requirement: The existing workspace is the unit of use: it can hold flat native content, model documents, independent laboratory roots, spatial views and referenced data from other Organs. Hosting exposes an authorized projection of those same contents to participants. Modeling, ordinary work and multiplayer share persistence, accepted edits, source access, demand and resource policy; no separately named product or compulsory geographic/world root is introduced. Each participant has independent views and local interaction state while accepted shared scopes keep their owning authority.

normative_requirement_audit.scope_and_limits: B25 and B38 have unrelated roots/dimensions; generic runtime scale proof remains Stage 05.
normative_requirement_audit.original_requirement: Owner clarification, 2026-10-20: scale handling is scene-independent. The ping-pong-ball/Earth/solar-system journey is a reference acceptance example whose required capabilities must work together; its objects, hierarchy and endpoints are not engine facts or fixed zoom stages. The same frame, precision, representation, query, navigation and demand contracts apply to a room-only scene, an invented assembly spanning comparable scale ratios, a microscopic root or another authored world. Scene extent and supported precision/resource profiles bound actual operations; no chosen example establishes a universal smallest object, largest scene or required root. Earth remains available as the geographic preset/data choice already agreed, without allocation in an unrelated scene.

normative_requirement_audit.scope_and_limits: Synthetic street and favorite-place proxies; actual offline city coverage remains Stage 06.
normative_requirement_audit.original_requirement: The priority is an offline personal world: very coarse Earth context, a navigable city, and detailed attractive places the user cares about. Home, work, university and community spaces can have authored interiors, material assignments, mounted Sands and useful behavior while the rest of the world remains simple. Fictional places and alternative designs have the same authoring capabilities. Earth is an optional reference system, not a required root for every model.

normative_requirement_audit.scope_and_limits: Direct material choice and independent micro/laboratory endpoints retain distinct deferred purposes.
normative_requirement_audit.original_requirement: Both directions of work are first-class. A person can assemble a wall from an empirical material and measured dimensions, then add finer evidence later; another can study a crystal and explicitly derive one property used by that wall. Zooming never invents atoms, unseen rooms, survey accuracy or material behavior. Refinement can add geometry, knowledge or a better physical model independently.

normative_requirement_audit.scope_and_limits: Shared K/I/E contracts with specialist mathematics, not a universal numerical representation.
normative_requirement_audit.original_requirement: The architectural goal is a small common model language plus domain implementations. Geometry, material science, CAD, geography, biology and operational workflows share identity, units, frames, selections, dependencies, revisions and results. They retain the representations and algorithms their mathematics requires. A general field interface does not make a molecular force field, a rigid-body force, an electromagnetic field and a stock balance interchangeable.

normative_requirement_audit.scope_and_limits: Early scale/hosting and flat fallback retained; new physical sciences deferred.
normative_requirement_audit.original_requirement: Owner-confirmed delivery emphasis, updated 2026-10-21: shared foundations → early scene-independent sparse scale/navigation and hosting → offline locality, authored rooms/caves, low-poly optimization, source comparison, CAD/assemblies, structural microscopic editing and operational composition → stabilization gate → deferred material-property evaluation, laboratory experiments and new physical simulation. The paired direct-material, micro-derived-model and independent protein workflows remain required in the deferred tail and share the same implementation. [stage 05](05-stage.md) still proves the optional solar-system/default-Earth/street/house/40 mm ball example and B38 independent scenes early. Default ground has no relief and absent building geometry stays absent until supplied data or user authoring changes it; the globe itself remains curved. Generic behavior must support interactive authored experiences without requiring a separate game architecture.

normative_requirement_audit.scope_and_limits: Current native baseline and 36 targeted checks passed; fixtures/contracts and scoped qualitative review are complete. This does not certify future model/navigation/hosting/scientific runtime features.
normative_requirement_audit.original_requirement: **C08 — Completion requires intent and evidence.** Every implementation slice proves the relevant user action, backend invariant, native UI, failure handling and resource behavior. A generic extension point or a favorable library benchmark never completes a domain feature.

normative_requirement_audit.scope_and_limits: Paths and limits audited; existing targeted tests passed without certifying larger future workloads.
normative_requirement_audit.original_requirement: This inspection establishes reuse candidates and present limits. Recheck before coding because the working tree is shared and other work is changing it. No existing subsystem is certified for the larger scope solely by its name.

normative_requirement_audit.scope_and_limits: Eight modeling primitive families registered with explicit first consumers.
normative_requirement_audit.original_requirement: The shared families proposed by this pass are: durable model objects and occurrences; frame/unit transformations; spatial support and named selections; typed quantities and fields; domain relations and constraints; revisioned derivations; representations and detail; and isolated runtime state. The following contracts define their members and behavior before project code changes.

normative_requirement_audit.scope_and_limits: H1–H10 attach to shared families and existing authority, without a separate model service.
normative_requirement_audit.original_requirement: Hosting reuses these families through participant/session authority, permitted query projections, bounded asset delivery and activities. Its H1–H10 requirements attach to L0–L5 and the existing engine/transport/native ownership below. They are cross-boundary contracts, not another model layer or a universal collaboration service outside current workspace policy.

normative_requirement_audit.scope_and_limits: Prior art does not select a replacement framework or establish Lince performance.
normative_requirement_audit.original_requirement: Research checked 2026-10-18. The recommendations below infer useful design boundaries from primary documentation/source; they do not select a replacement database/framework, import vendor benchmarks as Lince targets or authorize copying a codebase. Preserve the native Rust direction and existing accepted-state/asset contracts unless a measured stage proves a missing mechanism.

normative_requirement_audit.scope_and_limits: Fixture adapter record declares versions/rights, units/conventions, supported/unsupported operations and phase proofs.
normative_requirement_audit.original_requirement: Every selected adapter records: supported schema/operations; exact software/build/license/target platforms; units/frames/conventions; source and subelement identity; unsupported/loss behavior; deterministic/tolerance reproducibility; resource/cancellation guarantees; failure and crash recovery; and reference fixtures/results. “Library supports X” is not a completed Lince capability until persistence, native interaction and this record pass.

normative_requirement_audit.scope_and_limits: Standard bounded GLB inspection selected for the small inputs; no speculative CAD/meshing/science kernel installed.
normative_requirement_audit.original_requirement: Choose one implementation per initial purpose. A renderer, geometric kernel, mesher and numerical solver solve different problems; selecting all of them at once is unnecessary. Time-box a candidate evaluation to the fixture list and make a recorded selection or fallback decision. A failed optional dependency must not invalidate a saved document or prevent inspecting retained results.

normative_requirement_audit.scope_and_limits: Current native baseline and 36 targeted checks passed; fixtures/contracts and scoped qualitative review are complete. This does not certify future model/navigation/hosting/scientific runtime features.
normative_requirement_audit.original_requirement: Before coding a slice, instantiate its work card in this document with: **intent and exact user action; C/K/I/E/H requirements; inputs and units/frame/revision; accepted outputs and native states; owning module/authority; required/deferred profile operations; dependencies; fixture and reference result; numeric performance/error/resource thresholds; failure/recovery cases; checks/observed evidence; participant/source authority, activity location and resource payer where hosted; and remaining decisions**. Use existing stage tasks and requirements as the specification, not a newly invented summary. A library/API/empty UI scaffold is not completion.

normative_requirement_audit.scope_and_limits: All required Stage 01 proofs and retained capability paragraphs are present; the general registry is Verified. Later implementation remains Pending/Deferred.
normative_requirement_audit.original_requirement: The stage registry starts Pending for core delivery and Deferred for the numerical tail. Move to In progress only within agreed implementation authorization, then Verified or Blocked with concrete evidence/reason; use Repair required for a previously verified contract that regresses until its repair passes; retain Deferred for unstarted future scope. Record a completed capability and proof location before removing its implementation checklist, so the remaining document does not lose the governing invariant. The ledger does not add a new permission prompt for routine authorized work. Never mark a feature built solely because a test stub, generic profile slot or tiny unrelated benchmark passes.

normative_requirement_audit.scope_and_limits: Current native baseline and 36 targeted checks passed; fixtures/contracts and scoped qualitative review are complete. This does not certify future model/navigation/hosting/scientific runtime features.
normative_requirement_audit.original_requirement: Each stage has an intention regression: preserve at least one relevant earlier user flow while adding the next shared capability. Broaden checks only for actual changes/failures/unresolved concerns. Performance runs must record build/profile/device/data/accuracy and compare like for like; vendor throughput numbers are not thresholds. Failures change the implementation or explicitly agreed budget, not the meaning of the feature.

normative_requirement_audit.scope_and_limits: Existing development observations are recorded with sample counts/limits and performance findings. Future optimized navigation targets remain unchanged and unverified; unavailable GPU/copy/query/streaming measurements are not zero or a pass.

normative_requirement_audit.original_requirement: First useful view — **Proposed starting value:** ≤3 s cold local open, ≤1 s warm after the required root/index is available — **Enforcement/evidence:** Display useful coarse content without waiting for optional refinements; record asset and OS-cache conditions

normative_requirement_audit.scope_and_limits: Small-job/decode limits selected before their consuming runtime; actual upload byte/time quota selection remains with Stage 05 implementation.
normative_requirement_audit.original_requirement: Job scheduling — **Proposed starting value:** Initially two heavy background jobs, one expensive decode per source, bounded uploads per frame — **Enforcement/evidence:** Byte/upload/tile caps derive from the fixture; preserve input responsiveness and fair queues

normative_requirement_audit.scope_and_limits: Acknowledgement, dispatch stop, yield and termination have separate targets.
normative_requirement_audit.original_requirement: Cancellation — **Proposed starting value:** Local UI acknowledgement ≤100 ms, obsolete dispatch stops ≤250 ms; cooperative workers yield/check ≤100 ms — **Enforcement/evidence:** Noncooperative kernels have a process timeout/termination policy, proposed 2 s; pending termination is visible

normative_requirement_audit.scope_and_limits: Fixture identity/frames/geometry and existing receipt/isolation checks; future numerical validity remains with its owner.
normative_requirement_audit.original_requirement: Correctness combines geometry/topology validity, stable identity, units/frame/clock transformations, material applicability, mapping, exact accounting, revision conflicts and actual user interactions. Use property/metamorphic tests where meaningful: unit changes preserve physical predictions; rigid frame changes preserve lengths; view magnification does not change physics; permutation preserves identity; equal/opposite additive effects cancel; display simplification does not change accepted mass/stock; origin shifts preserve canonical state.

normative_requirement_audit.scope_and_limits: The current eight-test suite passed, including actual-buffer bounds rejection and existing path/rights/parser/reference/geometry negatives; existing authority tests passed. Future delivery/worker boundaries remain with their owning stages.
normative_requirement_audit.original_requirement: Security checks target actual boundaries: denied edits across UI/API/import/automation; private metadata/index/result disclosure; stale caches after grants change; source/observation forgery; bounded parsers/archives/decoders; integer overflow in shape/offset math; traversal/symlink/duplicate-entry handling; cyclic expansion; unintended network requests; credential scope; executable worker capabilities; cancellation and quota exhaustion. Retained caches/results respect their own rights. Simulations cannot emit operational Actions into the live Cell.

Record p95/p99, cancellation latency, CPU/RAM/VRAM, bytes read/transferred, peak staging and released demand/resources after closure. Test one dense room, a sparse city, many instances, overlapping appearance layers and a long navigation session separately.
